name: Brent Crude Oil Rips & G10 FX: USD/CAD, EUR/USD and AUD/USD Forward Returns
description: Event study analyzing USD/CAD, EUR/USD, and AUD/USD forward returns (5d, 10d, 20d) following Brent crude oil rip events — defined as a 63-day rolling return crossing above 30% with a 63-bar cooldown between events. Covers 20 years of data. Includes summary table with event count, average forward returns and hit rates (per-pair directional convention), a grouped bar chart comparing the three FX pairs across horizons, and event markers on each rip date.
source:
# =============================================================================
# BRENT CRUDE OIL RIPS & G10 FX: USD/CAD, EUR/USD AND AUD/USD FORWARD RETURNS
# =============================================================================
# Event: Brent crude 63-day rolling return crosses above 30%
#        with a 63-bar cooldown between events (debounce)
# FX convention:
#   USDCAD: positive return = USD stronger / CAD weaker
#   EURUSD: positive return = EUR stronger / USD weaker
#   AUDUSD: positive return = AUD stronger / USD weaker (commodity currency)
# Hit rate direction:
#   USDCAD: hit = return < 0 (CAD strengthens, USDCAD falls)
#   EURUSD: hit = return > 0 (EUR strengthens, EURUSD rises)
#   AUDUSD: hit = return > 0 (AUD strengthens, AUDUSD rises)
# Forward returns: 5d, 10d, 20d post-event (look-ahead, event study only)
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close_fx = src.c
bar_idx = index()

# =============================================================================
# BRENT CRUDE DATA (SC FUTURES — continuous series)
# =============================================================================

brent_raw = reference_futures(ticker="SC")()
brent_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio
)(brent_raw.o, brent_raw.h, brent_raw.l, brent_raw.c, brent_raw.v, brent_raw.oi, brent_raw.s)
brent_close = ffill(brent_cont.c)

# =============================================================================
# BRENT 63-DAY ROLLING RETURN (bar-based lag — single reference asset)
# =============================================================================

brent_63d_ago = brent_close >> 63
brent_63d_ret = (brent_close - brent_63d_ago) / brent_63d_ago

# =============================================================================
# EVENT DETECTION: First cross above 50% with 63-bar cooldown
# =============================================================================

# Raw crossover: first bar where 63d return crosses above 30%
raw_cross = crossover(brent_63d_ret, 0.30)

# Debounce: suppress if previous crossover was < 63 bars ago
# barssince(raw_cross >> 1) = bars since last crossover on any prior bar
bars_since_prev = coalesce(barssince()(raw_cross >> 1), 999)
is_oil_rip = raw_cross and (bars_since_prev >= 63)

# =============================================================================
# FORWARD RETURNS FOR FX PAIRS (look-ahead — event study methodology)
# =============================================================================

# Raw FX forward returns (positive = pair appreciated)
fx_post5d  = ((close_fx << 5)  - close_fx) / close_fx
fx_post10d = ((close_fx << 10) - close_fx) / close_fx
fx_post20d = ((close_fx << 20) - close_fx) / close_fx

# Brent return on event bar (for event marker context)
ev_brent_ret = where(is_oil_rip, brent_63d_ret)

# =============================================================================
# EVENT-FILTERED FORWARD RETURN SERIES
# =============================================================================

rip_post5d  = where(is_oil_rip, fx_post5d)
rip_post10d = where(is_oil_rip, fx_post10d)
rip_post20d = where(is_oil_rip, fx_post20d)

# Hit-rate helpers: 1.0 if FX moved in the "expected" direction on event
# USDCAD: oil rip → CAD strengthens → USDCAD falls → negative return is "hit"
# EURUSD: oil rip → USD weakens → EURUSD rises → positive return is "hit"
# AUDUSD: oil rip → AUD strengthens → AUDUSD rises → positive return is "hit"
# Per-asset routing via is_asset_ref + conditional_select so cs_summary_table
# picks the correct directional hit series for each FX pair row.
usdcad_hit5  = where(is_oil_rip, 1.0 if fx_post5d  < 0 else 0.0)
usdcad_hit10 = where(is_oil_rip, 1.0 if fx_post10d < 0 else 0.0)
usdcad_hit20 = where(is_oil_rip, 1.0 if fx_post20d < 0 else 0.0)
eurusd_hit5  = where(is_oil_rip, 1.0 if fx_post5d  > 0 else 0.0)
eurusd_hit10 = where(is_oil_rip, 1.0 if fx_post10d > 0 else 0.0)
eurusd_hit20 = where(is_oil_rip, 1.0 if fx_post20d > 0 else 0.0)
audusd_hit5  = where(is_oil_rip, 1.0 if fx_post5d  > 0 else 0.0)
audusd_hit10 = where(is_oil_rip, 1.0 if fx_post10d > 0 else 0.0)
audusd_hit20 = where(is_oil_rip, 1.0 if fx_post20d > 0 else 0.0)

# Asset identity flags for per-row hit rate routing
is_usdcad = is_asset_ref(ticker="USDCAD")()
is_eurusd = is_asset_ref(ticker="EURUSD")()
is_audusd = is_asset_ref(ticker="AUDUSD")()

# Routed hit series: each asset row gets its own directional hit rate
hit5  = conditional_select(is_usdcad, usdcad_hit5,  is_eurusd, eurusd_hit5,  audusd_hit5)
hit10 = conditional_select(is_usdcad, usdcad_hit10, is_eurusd, eurusd_hit10, audusd_hit10)
hit20 = conditional_select(is_usdcad, usdcad_hit20, is_eurusd, eurusd_hit20, audusd_hit20)

# =============================================================================
# CHART 1: Brent 63-day rolling return with 50% event threshold
# =============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='Brent Crude 63-Day Rolling Return',
    category='Brent Oil Rip & FX',
    y_axis_label='63-Day Return',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    area=True,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Brent 63d Return', color=Color.Orange)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.30, title='30% Rip Threshold', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=0
)(bar_idx, brent_63d_ret)

# =============================================================================
# CHART 2: Average forward returns by horizon — cs_bars grouped by FX pair
# =============================================================================

cs_bars(
    title='Avg FX Forward Return After Brent 30%+ Rip (by Horizon)',
    category='Brent Oil Rip & FX',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    y_axis_label='Avg Forward Return',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    series_names=['Post-5d', 'Post-10d', 'Post-20d'],
    order=1
)((rip_post5d, rip_post10d, rip_post20d))

# =============================================================================
# TABLE: Event count, avg forward returns, and hit rates per FX pair
# =============================================================================

cs_summary_table(
    title='Brent Oil Rip (30%+) FX Impact: Forward Returns & Hit Rates',
    category='Brent Oil Rip & FX',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='Brent Oil Rip (30%+) FX Impact',
        include_timestamp=False,
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Event Count',        type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0,  grid_agg=AggregationType.Count),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Post-5d Return',  type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Post-10d Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Post-20d Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hit Rate 5d',         type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hit Rate 10d',        type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Hit Rate 20d',        type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean)
        ]
    ),
    order=2
)(rip_post5d, rip_post5d, rip_post10d, rip_post20d, hit5, hit10, hit20)

# =============================================================================
# EVENT MARKERS: Mark each Brent rip event with forward FX returns
# =============================================================================

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Brent Oil Rip (30%+ / 63d)',
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero,    title='Brent 63d Return',   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='FX Post-5d Return',  type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='FX Post-10d Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='FX Post-20d Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(is_oil_rip, ev_brent_ret, rip_post5d, rip_post10d, rip_post20d)
